purpose: Teach: フライパン/ティーン/ステッカー/サボっ/つぼみ/吠え/きゅう/じわじわ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいフライパン、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、使っているのよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Aoi, you're really actually using that new pan all the time, aren't you? I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, admiring opening. Bright energy with genuine affection underneath. Leans in with a smile, almost teasing but sincere. Quick pace, light.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵のお客様、本気で、絶対、ティーン世代も、絶対、多いのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Yeah. I've got a lot more teenage customers coming in lately, actually. It's been surprising.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly bemused. Noticing something she hadn't quite expected. Soft, reflective tone. A pause before answering, like she's considering it even as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵オリジナルの、本気で、絶対、ステッカー、絶対、可愛いよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、コレクション
lines.en: Your original stickers are so cute—I actually want to collect them all.
lines.style: Animated, genuine delight. A little unselfconscious. Warm energy without performing. Quick, eager inflection on the sticker comment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: バイト、本気で、絶対、サボったらダメよね、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、徹底してるよ
lines.en: I can't slack off at work, though. I take it seriously—it matters to me.
lines.style: Shifts to something steadier, more grounded. Quiet conviction, not defensive. Matter-of-fact but with care underneath. A moment of genuine seriousness breaking through the lightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお庭、本気で、絶対、桜のつぼみ、絶対、見えるわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your garden's cherry blossoms are starting to bud—they look beautiful this year.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost tender. Voice quieter, more vulnerable. Noticing something small and lovely. Gentle smile in the voice, no rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の犬、本気で、絶対、店内、絶対、吠えないように、絶対、躾けされてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even my customers' dogs are well-behaved in the shop—they don't bark. Everyone's so respectful of the space.
lines.style: Reflective, a little amazed by her own success. Voice carries quiet pride. Calm, measured delivery. She's noticing how much she's built without quite meaning to.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、葵、本気で、絶対、きゅうに、絶対、お客様、絶対、増えてきたわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, your business has really picked up suddenly these past few weeks. I've noticed more people coming in.
lines.style: Warm and encouraging, with genuine admiration. A little excited about what she's seeing. Open, generous tone. Slight emphasis on the growth—she's been watching and wants Aoi to know she sees it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の評判、本気で、絶対、じわじわと、絶対、広がっているわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Your reputation is spreading, quietly but steadily. I'm really happy about it.
lines.style: Gentle, tender warmth. A soft smile is audible. Words come slowly, each one chosen with care. Close, intimate tone—like she's sharing something important. Trailing warmth on the final words.
